description: This file defines database operations related to a Tic-Tac-Toe game, including creating games, adding moves, finalizing games, and retrieving game data. It includes functions for managing game lifecycle and accessing game/move records stored in a SQL database.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_game(game_id: str)
methods.description: Creates a new game entry in the database with a unique game ID and timestamp.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_move(game_id: str, move_number: int, player: str, position: int)
methods.description: Records a move made by a player in a specific game, including move number, position, and timestamp.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] finalize_game(game_id: str, result: Optional[str], final_board: str)
methods.description: Updates a game record with final result, finished timestamp, and final board state.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_game(game_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches complete game data including moves, based on game ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_games(limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Provides a paginated list of recent game summaries.

ctags.name: add_move
ctags.pattern: /^def add_move(game_id: str, move_number: int, player: str, position: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
ctags.signature: (game_id: str, move_number: int, player: str, position: int)

ctags.name: finalize_game
ctags.pattern: /^def finalize_game(game_id: str, result: Optional[str], final_board: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: list_games
ctags.pattern: /^def list_games(limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
